blocks.t: Fits directly into existing Epic workflows
Heidi launches with patient and encounter context already in place, so clinicians can start immediately within Epic without an additional system or login, enabling use across teams and departments.
10 hours per clinician per week
Saved on documentation, reducing after-hours work and eliminating copy-paste.
65% adoption in the first month
Achieved across clinical teams without workflow changes, additional systems, or logins.
200+ specialties using Heidi
Used across inpatient, outpatient, and emergency settings.

blocks.t: How Heidi integrates with Epic
Heidi captures documentation during the encounter and writes it back to Epic as drafts aligned with Smart Data Elements and existing templates.
Embedded directly in Epic workflows
Launched from the patient chart in Hyperspace or Haiku, with patient and encounter context automatically in place.
Built on Epic’s native integration framework
Approved on Epic’s Showroom and compliant with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
Control at every step
Test, pilot, and scale at your pace. Full admin control supports safe, staged rollouts.

blocks.t: Roll out with control across your organization

Heidi is shaped around your clinicians, your workflows, and your rollout requirements. IT and clinical leadership can pilot, monitor usage, and scale adoption within your hospital’s governance processes. Deployment uses standard SMART on FHIR steps and requires IT configuration and approval.
